How do I download my capital gains statement?

You can download the statement from the Reports section of your profile.

Steps to download the statement:

  • Go to your profile.
  • Select the 'Reports' option.
  • Under 'Tax', choose 'Mutual Fund - Capital Gains'.
  • Select the financial year and click 'Download'.

Note: The report is generated for the selected financial year only.
